Why keeping up with trust is so hard

## Trust breaks when every team runs its own system

Regulations evolve. Systems change. New vendors enter the business before anyone fully assesses the risk. AI use spreads faster than teams can govern it. But the work is still scattered across spreadsheets, tickets, folders, and people. By the time teams piece together what changed, what matters, and who owns it, exposure has spread, costs have climbed, and the response is already late.

HOW IT WORKS

## One platform that turns change into control

Sprinto detects change as it happens, figures out what it impacts, takes the right next action, and keeps your security posture current for audits, security reviews, and board reporting.

1Step 1

2Step 2

3Step 3

4Step 4

1Step 1

### Detect the change

Sprinto continuously detects framework updates, contract changes, new vendors, policy updates, and expanding AI use without waiting for someone to notice.

![detect-wihout-waiting](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20721%20354'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

2Step 2

### Determine what it affects

Sprinto maps each change to the right controls, evidence, systems, assets, and owners, then determines what is already covered, what needs attention, and where risk is increasing.

![change-detected](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20753%20428'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

3Step 3

### Take the appropriate action

Sprinto starts with the right fix, then routes any review, approval, or follow-up with full context, assigns the right owner, and keeps things moving until the gap is closed.

![determine-next-action](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20744%20312'%3E%3C/svg%3E)

4Step 4

### Keep security posture current and easy to demonstrate

As controls drift, vendors change, and AI use expands, Sprinto keeps your security posture current with live monitoring and up-to-date evidence, then makes it easy to demonstrate that posture through AI Trust Center

![security-posture](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%20828%20233'%3E%3C/svg%3E)
